100105.text: Конечно! За кого ты меня принимаешь?

100107.text: Ну... если у тебя есть кто-то вроде сестры...

100108.text: Сестрёнка! Я думала, что нашла её, но...

100110.text: В таком случае я решу эту проблему по своему плану!

100111.text: Но в награду потребую жизненную энергию...

100113.text: Подумаю об этом, смотря как ты справишься!

100202.text: Не зазнавайся. Ты хоть понимаешь, что говоришь?

100203.text: Наверняка сюда попали и другие воительницы, как и мы...

100204.text: Понятно. О сильных воительницах лучше расспрашивать сильных воительниц...

100205.text: Отправлюсь странствовать по этому миру и искать воительниц!

100402.text: Похоже, враг что-то обронил. Теперь это наше!

100501.text: Воительниц можно призывать и с помощью осколков.

100502.text: Объединим осколки, полученные в прошлом бою.

100801.text: Чувствуешь, как растёт её сила? Продолжим!

101001.text: Используй свитки особого призыва, чтобы призвать воительниц!

101003.text: Особый призыв даёт высокий шанс получить сильных воительниц. Раз в день он бесплатный!

101102.text: Здесь можно получить много наград! Не забывай о бесплатном быстром бое раз в день.

101103.text: Быстрый бой приносит награды за 120 минут автобоя.

101104.text: С бонусом быстрого боя сражения проходят быстрее.

101301.text: Продолжим путь! Не забудь забрать боевые награды!

101303.text: Чем больше этапов пройдено, тем больше наград автобоя!

101401.text: Открой экран усиления, чтобы узнать больше о своём отряде.

101501.text: Снаряжай воительниц оружием и бронёй, чтобы повысить характеристики!

101601.text: Объединяй экипировку из приключений и магазинов, чтобы получить более мощную!

101701.text: Выполняй ежедневные задания и получай награды!

101801.text: Обменивай награды Полёта ангела на свитки призыва, руны и осколки воительниц!

101901.text: Повышай уровень славы, чтобы получить дополнительные преимущества!

102001.text: Получай опыт славы за ежедневный вход и пополнение!

102101.text: Объединяй и повышай ранг воительниц, чтобы улучшить характеристики!

102201.text:
Испытай силу улучшенных воительниц!
Стремись к вершине башни!

102301.text: Поднимайся на следующий этаж за материалами улучшения и самоцветами!

102401.text:
Сражайся с другими игроками на арене!
Здесь можно посмотреть построение противника.

102501.text:
Вступи в гильдию и сражайся вместе с союзниками!
Получай эксклюзивные предметы и бонусы характеристик 
для своих воительниц.

102601.text:
Бросай кости и отправляйся в приключение!
Ты можешь найти материалы улучшения и осколки воительниц!

102701.text:
Добывай материалы и предметы в святилище для усиления артефактов.
Боевой пропуск даёт дополнительные награды!

102801.text: Тренируй воительниц, чтобы повысить уровень источника.

102901.text: Повышай уровень, чтобы улучшить характеристики всех воительниц!

103001.text: Собирай материалы в святилище, чтобы получить мощные артефакты!

103101.text: Набери 300 очков кузницы, чтобы выбрать и получить артефакт!

103201.text: Собирай реликвии, чтобы улучшить характеристики воительницы!

103301.text: Собирай особые позы и облики, чтобы открывать записи каталога. Это значительно усилит воительниц!

103401.text:
Сражайся в пещере во всех режимах!
Здоровье воительниц между боями не восстанавливается. Отправляй сильнейших!

Добро пожаловать на боевую арену!
Сейчас узнаешь правила мини-игры.
Выбери персонажа и участвуй в пошаговых поединках 1 на 1 против игроков или компьютера.
Игровые монеты нужны для подбора соперников и получения ценных наград.
У каждого персонажа боевой арены свои особенности. Для начала попробуй сбалансированную Лейну.
На боевой арене доступны обучение, тренировочный бой и бой с игроком.
В обучении используй Лейну и Элину, чтобы освоить бой.
В тренировочном бою можно тренировать любимого персонажа против компьютера.
В боях с игроками используй игровые монеты, сражайся с соперниками со всего мира и получай ценные награды.
Начнём обучение!

В боях с игроками используй игровые монеты, сражайся с соперниками со всего мира и получай ценные награды.
Начнём обучение!

Боевая арена — пошаговая мини-игра в жанре файтинга. 
Каждый ход доступны 4 действия: лёгкая атака, тяжёлая атака, защита или завершающий удар.
Лёгкая атака побеждает тяжёлую, тяжёлая пробивает защиту, а защита отражает лёгкую атаку.
Завершающий удар побеждает остальные 3 действия, но расходует шкалу. Если противник тоже использует завершающий удар, оба удара отменяются.
Отправляемся в бой!
Каждый ход выбирай действие до истечения времени. Если ничего не выбрать, бой продолжится автоматически.
Исход боя определяется, если выносливость обоих участников достигнет 0.
Когда число оставшихся ходов достигнет 0, побеждает участник с большим запасом здоровья. При равном здоровье объявляется ничья.
Попробуем! Противник использует лёгкую атаку. Выбери защиту.
Следующей будет тяжёлая атака противника. Ответь лёгкой атакой!
Противник защищается. Используй тяжёлую атаку, чтобы пробить защиту.
Шкала заполнена, завершающий удар готов. Нанеси огромный урон!
У противника осталось мало выносливости. Победи его, используя изученные приёмы!
При каждом призыве можно получить награды и шанс найти ящик припасов.

To Unlock Supply Boxes, you need to Use keys. Chests are divided into Normal and III Chests, and III Chests have a higher Chance to obtain high Rank Rewards. When Unlocking a Chest, you will Use a corresponding Amount of keys based on the value of the items inside the Chest.
Skyward Battle Training has been unlocked. Participate to obtain Tower Pt. The higher your Tower Pt, the better the rewards.
During the Event period, complete Tasks, Obtain the specified Amount of Tenrou Pt, and reach the specified Rank and Rank to Obtain Rewards.
Roaring Dragon Tail Training has been unlocked. During this season, Static effects are significantly enhanced.
In the Event, the Player's Stats are affected by the Upgrade progress of Warrior Training. Outside the Event, only Skills are carried into the Event, and other Stats are not carried over.
The Training Island has been unlocked. When you explore the Training Island, you can obtain a large amount of Warrior Training Gear and Training EXP.
If you own specific Warriors, Summoned Beasts, or Angel Crests, the Season-exclusive Enhancement and RES Effect will be greatly increased. The higher the rank, the greater the effect.
Stat Amplification becomes active after your stats increase and you tap to unlock it.
When the Season is Unlocked, a certain Amount of Training Tasks are Updated every week. If you complete All Training Tasks, you can Obtain Premium Rewards.
After the Event starts, Ranks are Confirmed based on the Battle Power Rank within the Event and recorded in the Hall of Fame. After the Event ends, Rewards are distributed according to Rank.
Training Battle has been unlocked. By participating in the Training Battle, you can obtain a large amount of Rewards.
The Skyward Battle Training has been unlocked. Participate and raise your rank to obtain a large amount of rewards.
On the Island of Training, there are 5 base Areas and 1 Core Area that Players can Explore. You can Unlock base Areas after a certain amount of Time has passed.
When you Win the Boss in an Area, it is considered that you have Cleared that Area. When you Clear an Area, the Task NPCs, gathering nodes, the Training Maze, and the Boss Takedown are Updated.
This area has been cleared. The task NPCs, the traveling merchant, gathering items, and legacies have been updated. One random takedown boss will spawn in a completed area 2 days after clearing.
Items obtained through gathering can be donated at [Rugged Boulder Island]. Unlock the Guild mode Takedown Battle at Rugged Boulder Island by meeting the donation requirements.
[Rugged Boulder Island] has been unlocked. Registration opens daily after 1:00 AM, and the raid begins at 9:00 PM. The event lasts 1 hour, and higher damage dealt results in better rewards.

The continent that has cast off the veil of Mystery has revealed itself. The Blossoms energy of Warrior training is born here. Join the Training Battle and strengthen the power of your own Warrior training Blossoms.
Crush other Guilds in the Training Battle and earn Premium Rewards.
Read the guide and join the Training Battle!
This is your Base. After being defeated in a Fight, you will revive here. Other players cannot declare war on your Base.
You can edit your team here. The team’s Battle Power increases according to Warrior training.
You can discover several Mystery territories around your base. When you Conquer them, they will produce Enhance Materials for Warrior training.
Only territories around the Guild Fortress can be attacked.
Beautiful Warrior Training can increase the Team's Battle Power. During the season, the Beautiful Warrior Training corresponding to the current season greatly increases stats within the Season Event.
Use Coins and Training EXP to level up Warrior Training and enhance the Team Stats.
Use Warrior Training Shards to Rank Up Warrior Training. After Ranking Up, you can greatly increase the Battle Power of Warrior Training and the Warriors in the current Battle Formation!
Warrior training Gear has a total of 12 parts, and the higher the Level and Rank, the stronger the Gear becomes. By increasing the Warrior training Level, you can Obtain higher-Level Gear.
Consume Crystal Core I and Crystal Core III to unlock Warrior Training Bloom.
When Beautiful Warrior Training levels up, the level of Training Gear that can be obtained in Season Mode also increases.
We have supplies that need transporting. Complete the transport mission to obtain premium rewards.
Transport Task is dispatched here.
When starting an expedition, pay attention to the team's Status and Time. If the required conditions are not met, you cannot send them.
After selecting a team, click Transport to dispatch them to carry out the transport. Be aware that other teams can assault you during transport, .
Transport Team Discovered. Assault them to obtain Raid Rewards.
Select a plunder target, and if the plunder is successful, you can obtain some of the supplies being transported.
A powerful incarnation of the underworld has invaded this land. Gather your strength and head out for the Takedown. If you succeed, you can obtain immense power and great Rewards.
Select a Takedown Team to perform a Takedown and Obtain Rewards according to the DMG dealt.
Depending on the Amount of DMG dealt to the Boss, you can obtain different Amounts of Rewards, and if you achieve the Takedown first, you can obtain additional rewards and a powerful buff
The Treasure feature has been unlocked. You can equip them to raise the Warrior's Stats. Let's check it out!
Each Class has its own EX Treasure that can be collected, and equipping it can increase the Warrior's Battle Power. In addition, you can unlock Special Effects with EX Treasures.
You can use the treasure collection feature to obtain treasure.
The Treasure Collection feature has been unlocked. Let's take a look!
In the Treasure Display, you can dismantle and enhance treasures, as well as obtain items that can be used for collection or enhancement at set time intervals.

storyChapters.title: Gift of an Angel
storyChapters.content:
Elina continues to fight and win battles against Beautiful Warriors from other worlds.
Nanael offers Elina a special gift.

storyChapters.title: Follow your Sister
storyChapters.content: When Claudette visits Elina's room, she falls in love with something displayed in the corner of the room.

storyChapters.title: Mysterious Armor
storyChapters.content:
Elina and her friends manage to overcome the crisis.
However, the lazy angel brings more disasters.

storyChapters.title: Looking for my Sister
storyChapters.content: Elina and the others rush to protect Leina from danger.

storyChapters.title: Port Town Lighthouse
storyChapters.content: Liliana visited a port town to get a ship in order to go to the desert as quickly as possible.

storyChapters.title: Lost Forest
storyChapters.content: While lost in the forest, Risty met Wisteria, who lives in a tower.

storyChapters.title: Anthill Desert
storyChapters.content: Liliana and her friend landed in the desert. There, they found a huge hill crawling with ants.

storyChapters.title: Angel's Mountain
storyChapters.content:
Upon arriving at the mountain, Risty was once again lost.
Someone spoke to her...

storyChapters.title: The Real Treasure
storyChapters.content:
Risty and Liliana finally reached the area with the final treasure.
The map points to the location, but...

storyChapters.title: The Descended Master Samurai
storyChapters.content: In front of Tomoe, who is being attacked by bandits, a girl armed with swords descended from the sky.

storyChapters.title: The Summoned Master Samurai
storyChapters.content: Aldra was trying to summon a demon with her magic. However, she summoned an uncontrollable monster.

storyChapters.title: Rice Ball and Strategy Meeting
storyChapters.content: Tomoe and Jubei headed towards the market to have a meal and look for "Yukki".

storyChapters.title: Fight Kumadouji!
storyChapters.content:
Jubei and Yukimura finally reunited.
A plan to take down Kumadouji is being devised, involving Tomoe and Aldra!

storyChapters.title: Fireworks Show Invitation
storyChapters.content: Cattleya was running her shop as usual...

storyChapters.title: Seeking Power
storyChapters.content: Ymir and Eilin started making a fireworks mortar.

storyChapters.title: Looking for sparkles
storyChapters.content: Cattleya and Bloom try to craft rainbow-colored gunpowder.

storyChapters.title: Flower of the Night
storyChapters.content: On festival day...

storyChapters.title: Murasaki's Choice
storyChapters.content: Murasaki learns that the Evil Hand is sealed inside Bebeby. She also learns that the world will be in danger if the Evil Hand isn't defeated, but even with that knowledge, she just can't give up her dear friend Bebeby...

storyChapters.title: Battle With the Evil Hand
storyChapters.content: Murasaki and everyone else move to the town outskirts. To save Bebeby and the entire world, the girls must face the Evil Hand in this place...

storyChapters.title: Invitation
storyChapters.content: The group, who has arrived at the sea, splits up and starts searching for monsters.

storyChapters.title: Beach Treasure Hunt
storyChapters.content: Philia, who was asked to exterminate a sea monster, reunites with Liliana...

storyChapters.title: Confused
storyChapters.content: Shieldaly and Mirim rescued from the octopus, the four of them set off again to search for monsters.

storyChapters.title: Cutting through the sea.
storyChapters.content: The four of them decide to find a seashell that would serve as a catalyst and proceed into the sea with Philia's magic.

storyChapters.title: Attack, Huge Monster!
storyChapters.content: The long-awaited monster with the crown finally appears. In order to rescue Philia, Shieldaly comes up with an idea...

storyChapters.title: Teleported
storyChapters.content: After waking up, they found themselves in a strange place.

storyChapters.title: Outbreak
storyChapters.content: Mirim went to town for some shopping, but...

storyChapters.title: Epidemic
storyChapters.content: Nyx was supposed to wake up as usual, but...

storyChapters.title: Strategy
storyChapters.content: Nyx, Mirim, Rei, Saeko, and Saya had finally managed to meet up...

storyChapters.title: Taking the Plunge
storyChapters.content: In order to face "them", the group started their operation!

storyChapters.title: Leina Joins The Battle!
storyChapters.content: While training, Leina received an invitation to the Arena...

storyChapters.title: The Arena Begins!
storyChapters.content: Leina registered for the Arena. Let the battle begin...

storyChapters.title: A Heated First Match!
storyChapters.content: After the opening ceremony, it's finally time for the tournament!

storyChapters.title: Nanael's Plan
storyChapters.content: After her victory, Leina decided to hear what Nanael had to say...

storyChapters.title: Fierce Battle! Is it The Finals?!
storyChapters.content: Just as Leina and Risty's final match was about to begin...

storyChapters.title: Reunion with the Summoner
storyChapters.content: Forced to face a magical beast, Aldra attempts a summoning and ends up summoning someone else instead...

storyChapters.title: Rumored Beautiful Warrior Hunter
storyChapters.content: Jubei and Yukimura look for Musashi in town. They couldn't find her, but Sen and Hanzo hear of a rumor about someone hunting Beautiful Warriors...

storyChapters.title: Memorable Rice Ball
storyChapters.content: Seeing rice balls reminds Tomoe of sharing one with someone before. A mysterious warrior appears and suddenly challenges them...

storyChapters.title: Unexpected Reunion
storyChapters.content: Musashi refuses to return home, wanting to fight strong warriors. This prompts Jubei to challenge her.

storyChapters.title: Before the Duel
storyChapters.content: Jubei and everyone stay at an inn with Tomoe and Shizuka the night before the battle. Amidst chatter, Tomoe becomes curious about Omelette Rice...

storyChapters.title: The Search for The Strongest Warrior
storyChapters.content: Seeria visits the town where the Arena has just taken place to meet strong Beautiful Warriors.

storyChapters.title: The Turbaned Beautiful Warrior
storyChapters.content: A turbaned Beautiful Warrior appears at the Guild. She confidently accepts a request to hunt a magical beast that no one wants to take on. Seeria is intrigued...

storyChapters.title: Magical Beast Takedown, Now!
storyChapters.content: Seeria learns firsthand how strong Fistar is. Together, they head for the forest to take on the magical beast.

storyChapters.title: A Greatsword That Can Cut Darkness
storyChapters.content: Seeria and Fistar find themselves in a pinch, blinded by the darkness. In this desperate situation, someone swoops in to save them...

storyChapters.title: 3 Warriors Unite for the First Time
storyChapters.content: Seeria and Fistar are saved thanks to Aily. The 3 girls join forces to face the magical beast.

storyChapters.title: Bird Monster Invasion
storyChapters.content: After getting out of the long tunnel, the 3 girls arrive at an unfamiliar town. They shop for ingredients right away, but problems keep coming up...

storyChapters.title: Giant Fish Catching!
storyChapters.content: The group arrives at the port town for the next ingredient, but they find that the bird monster also wreaked havoc here...

storyChapters.title: Unforeseen Rift
storyChapters.content: They get the third ingredient smoothly but the girls' opinions unexpectedly differ. This will have repercussions on the group later on...

storyChapters.title: What Goes Around Comes Around
storyChapters.content: The group solves their issue thanks to Pollyanna, who is actually there to return a favor.

storyChapters.title: Reason For The Rampage
storyChapters.content: The group come to the nest to get ingredients and defeat the rampaging bird monster. There, Asuka realizes something.

storyChapters.title: Fated Encounter
storyChapters.content: Zara finds her longtime enemy, Seiten, but Seiten is suddenly swept away into a rift that appeared between them...

storyChapters.title: A New Visitor
storyChapters.content: Zara learns that Hsien-Ko hails from another world. She promises to help Hsien-Ko return home, when a scream cuts through the air...

storyChapters.title: In the Majigen
storyChapters.content: From the rift, Seiten finds herself in an unfamiliar place. She learns from Morrigan, whom she meets, that they are in a place where chosen ones have gathered...

storyChapters.title: Dark Awakening
storyChapters.content: In the midst of their beast hunt, Zara and the others stumble into a mysterious place where they sense a strong, dark aura...

storyChapters.title: Facing the Dark
storyChapters.content: Seiten arrives at Jedah's castle and promptly challenges him. She discovers that he is indeed a Dark Lord of Makai...

storyChapters.title: Each Path
storyChapters.content: Zara and Felicia faces Jedah in battle and struggle to defeat a powerful opponent. An unexpected presence appears to rescue them...

storyChapters.title: Cattleya Weapons Shop
storyChapters.content: On this particular day, Cattleya's weapons shop had a somewhat unusual visitor. This customer had ordered weapons and armor for 1000 warriors...

storyChapters.title: Unfamiliar Caller
storyChapters.content: A strange Beautiful Warrior suddenly drops by the weapons shop. She offers Cattleya a job, with the reward of seeing her missing husband Owen.

storyChapters.title: Once-in-a-lifetime Chance
storyChapters.content: Due to a deal with Snow White, Kaguya comes to test Cattleya's skills. Although perplexed, Cattleya agrees to their terms to be reunited with her husband.

storyChapters.title: Cattleya VS Kaguya
storyChapters.content: The women move elsewhere to fight. A fierce battle between Cattleya, also known as the Giant Killer, and Kaguya, master of magical armor, takes place...

storyChapters.title: Outcome of Battle
storyChapters.content: Cattleya and Kaguya come to accept the other's strength as they fight. Time is almost up...

storyChapters.title: Pursuer and Evildoer
storyChapters.content: The girls wake up in an unknown place. Before they can gather their bearings, a woman named Lobryda asks for their help. Then Bebeby speaks up, telling them to help her...

storyChapters.title: Mysterious Fate
storyChapters.content: Heeding Bebeby's words, the three girls head for Vulko's castle to save Lobryda. They're overwhelmed by the number of guards upon entering the castle, when a thief who calls herself Robin offers her aid.

storyChapters.title: Evildoer's Confession
storyChapters.content: The girls are attacked once more by Vulko, who had been chasing after Lobryda. Then Vulko tells them an unexpected fact...

storyChapters.title: Murasaki's Choice
storyChapters.content: Murasaki learns that the Evil Hand is sealed inside Bebeby. She also learns that the world will be in danger if the Evil Hand isn't defeated, but even with that knowledge, she just can't give up her dear friend Bebeby...

storyChapters.title: Battle With the Evil Hand
storyChapters.content: Murasaki and everyone else move to the town outskirts. To save Bebeby and the entire world, the girls must face the Evil Hand in this place...

storyChapters.title: Visitor from Another World
storyChapters.content: The girls from another world who were summoned by the power of the Magatama. In order to return the girls to their original world, it is necessary to store power in the Magatama. At that moment, Aldra made a suggestion—

storyChapters.title: Omen of Darkness
storyChapters.content: The next day, the tournament truly begins. As the matches progress, the magatama steadily regains its power, but at the same time, Tomoe senses an ominous presence—

storyChapters.title: Magatama, Tainted
storyChapters.content: As the battle between Leina and Sonsaku heats up, the magatama suddenly turns black and murky, and once again a rift in space-time appears. From that rift emerges a dark figure, who, like Sonsaku and the others, seems to have come from another world—

storyChapters.title: Cooperative Move
storyChapters.content: Having lost his sanity, Musashi rampages through the Arena. Sonsaku and the others temporarily suspend the match and try to subdue Musashi together, but—

storyChapters.title: Rematch Under the Starlight
storyChapters.content: Under the starlight, Leina and Sonsaku face off once more. Sword and fist move in perfect sync, and their final blows are unleashed at the same moment. The outcome of this fierce, evenly matched battle is—

storyChapters.title: Guiding Light, Entrance to the Trial
storyChapters.content: At the Sacred Mountain, the Angel of Harmony appeared before Tomoe and told her that the true nature of the voice in her dreams would be revealed at the end of the Trial. Tomoe must face the Trial alone—

storyChapters.title: Body Balance—Bridge of Fluctuation
storyChapters.content: The second Trial is to cross an unsteady bridge while holding a vessel filled with water. If you get distracted by shaking or obstacles, the water will spill.

storyChapters.title: Balance of Mind—Corridor of Darkness
storyChapters.content: The third Trial was to proceed "straight ahead" through a pitch-black corridor. In the Dark, with no end in sight, whispering voices arose from nowhere, intensifying Tomoe’s unease and Terror—

storyChapters.title: Sweet Temptation—Illusion of the Flower Field
storyChapters.content: In the midst of the Trial, Shizuka and Leina, who were supposed to be waiting at the foot of the mountain, call out to Tomoe. Tomoe's mind wavered at the two's sweet temptations—

storyChapters.title: Facing the Shadow―The Reason for Wielding the Sword
storyChapters.content: Tomoe finally arrived at the Arena, where she was informed of the [Final Trial]. In the next moment, a Black Shadow flickers—its form somehow familiar. On the other side of her drawn blade, the air filled quietly with the tension of impending battle.

storyChapters.title: Prologue
storyChapters.content: In a dream of Future View, Seeria witnesses a festival of offerings in a desert village. But as the celebration nears its end, something strange stirs in the spring where the local brew was offered.

storyChapters.title: The Village Shown in the Dream
storyChapters.content: The desert village through Future View turns out to bear a striking resemblance to Fistar's hometown. With the traveling merchant Marcia joining the group, they set out for the village.

storyChapters.title: Desert Village Offering Festival
storyChapters.content: Arriving at Fistar's hometown, the party immerses themselves in the lively festival atmosphere. Yet seeing the village in person only deepens Seeria's unease — until unease becomes certainty.

storyChapters.title: Midnight Disturbance
storyChapters.content: Late at night, Seeria and Aily notice that the offering wine has gone missing. Following the trail, they discover it was Fistar who had been carrying the barrels.

storyChapters.title: Spirit's True Identity
storyChapters.content: Investigating the spring deep within the cave, the party begins to suspect that the voice they heard may belong to a monster masquerading as a spirit—

storyChapters.title: Monster Lurking in the Flames
storyChapters.content: On the day of the offering festival, what appears amid the flames during the ritual bears no resemblance to any spirit — it is the form of a monster!

storyChapters.title: Ending
storyChapters.content: With the monster defeated and peace restored to the desert village, Fistar finally learns the truth behind the legend.
